title: Preserved source representation is not automatically raw-source materialization
failure_signature: A content-verified PDF readable representation creates a document version and is silently relabeled materialized; or a research runner requires a GitHub Release/source-pack/raw-PDF download before already preserved claim-relevant content may enter Grounded Evidence; or locator existence alone is treated as claim proof.
root_cause: Earlier code conflated three different questions: whether an upstream document/locator is real, whether claim-relevant content was actually read and preserved, and whether byte-identical upstream raw bytes were downloaded. The same coupling leaked into a document-version trigger and source-pack-first orchestration contract, turning transport friction into a research blocker.
invariant: Source completeness is monotone but semantically distinct: locator_verified establishes source identity/locator only; content_verified requires actually read claim-relevant content plus a faithful preserved representation and may create document versions/Evidence without raw bytes; materialized requires an explicit verified raw-source version transition. A document_version alone never proves raw materialization. Research orchestration v2 verifies transport-neutral prepared material and must not require GitHub Release/source-pack/PDF download; legacy v1 remains replay compatibility only.
anti_regression: Do not add a generic document_versions trigger that marks every logical source document materialized.
Do not treat expected_sha256 of a readable representation as a raw-PDF hash unless raw bytes were actually verified.
Do not let locator_verified support claim-level Evidence when claim-relevant content was never read.
Do not make --source-pack or GitHub Release mandatory for research-orchestration/v2 or future default execution contracts.
Do not delete or rewrite legacy Release/source-pack receipts merely because the default transport policy changed; mark them legacy/superseded and preserve replayability.

guards.description: Raw materialization is an explicit verified transition tied to a document version.
Default orchestration verifies prepared local material rather than requiring a Release source pack.
Readable PDF representations carry truthful non-raw provenance into persistence.

revisit_when: Revisit only if Longcycle adopts a richer source-material graph that still separately preserves logical source identity, actually read claim content, representation bytes and explicit raw-source materialization without transport-specific Evidence prerequisites.
